newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: CIA chief visits South Korea, to meet president.
newsitem.headline: CIA chief visits South Korea, to meet president.

text.p: John Deutch, the Director of the U.S. Central Intelligence Agency (CIA) arrived in Seoul on Thursday for meetings with South Korean President Kim Young-sam and other senior officials, the U.S. Embassy said.
"Yes, he arrived today at the invitation of the South Korean government," said an embassy spokesman.
Deutch is in South Korea to discuss international security issues and global trends and concerns, Yonhap news agency reported.
When asked if last month's North Korean submarine incursion would be discussed, the embassy official said: "We can guess it probably will, but we don't know exactly what will be on the agenda.
No further details on the visit were available.
